name: Exploitation of Remote Services
summary: Adversaries may exploit a software vulnerability to take advantage of a programming error in a program, service, or within the operating system software or kernel itself to enable remote service abuse. A common goal for post-compromise exploitation of remote services is for initial access into and lateral movement throughout the ICS environment to enable access to targeted systems. ICS asset owners and operators have been affected by ransomware…

strategies.name: Detection of Exploitation of Remote Services

analytics.name: Analytic 1899
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a network-accessible service process (lsass.exe, a vendor remote management service) spawning an unexpected child process or exhibiting cross-process memory access patterns immediately following inbound connection from an unusual source. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

analytics.name: Analytic 2141
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an ICS Linux network-facing service spawning a shell, interpreter, or other child process outside the expected service-child baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

analytics.name: Analytic 2240
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies malformed, oversized, or out-of-spec ICS protocol messages sent to an embedded field device from an unexpected or unauthorized source. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. analytics.name: Analytic 2288
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies exploit-pattern ICS/network traffic, including malformed packets, out-of-spec function codes, or overflow-sized payloads, targeting ICS servers or field devices from unexpected sources. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): syscall=execve; shell/interpreter process is spawned by an ICS network-facing service or other unexpected parent process

log_sources.name: NSM:Content
log_sources.channel: malformed or oversized Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol message from unexpected source followed by device behavioral anomaly (reboot, mode change) within a short window

log_sources.name: zeek:conn
log_sources.channel: exploit-pattern traffic to Industrial Control Systems (ICS) server/device Internet Protocol (IP) from unexpected source, followed by behavioral anomaly within a short window
